title: UGV assembly and repair architecture
status: Preliminary design and task-gate specification; no hardware build or autonomy demonstration performed
summary: Build a peer from prepared industrial modules with independent lifting and fixtures first. General loose-parts manufacture and most/all self-repair remain research goals, not established capability.

baseline.massSource: Coordinated provisional mobility worker budget, not measured vehicle
baseline.budgetWarning: Dual bare arms+controllers already 152 kg. Lift, mounts, fixtures, hoses, enclosure, power, printer and supports must be explicitly allocated without double counting; carried autonomous lift can exceed current allowances. Suspension/steering mass 50/60 kg per corner is additional to the 110/135 kg wheel+drive figure; complete corners 160/195 kg.
baseline.workshopStabilizers: Offboard rated indexed fixture/support stands, not vehicle-mounted stabilizer mass in current workshop mobility budget. Cost line must be classified as infrastructure.

variants.name: Workshop / module-kit
infrastructure: Level indexed chassis fixture with mechanical supports
Independent goods-rated gantry/hoist and wheel cradles
Offboard metrology, safe electrical test station, air and power
Prepared trays with parts oriented and identity checked
robotWork: Insert captive fasteners with verified torque/angle
humanOrOffboard: Initial fixture setup and heavy lift rigging until automated tooling is validated
Battery pack, motor/gearbox, arm and harness manufacture
Safety-critical electrical acceptance and structural release

variants.name: Field / module-kit
variants.maturity: Higher-risk development extension; autonomous lift deployment unresolved
infrastructure: Firm surveyed repair pad, exclusion zone and weather protection
Ground mats, locked stabilizers/chassis supports and independent lift
Pretested sealed modules, keyed blind-mate interfaces and clean tool rack
Independent support energy for service controller and hoist
robotWork: Peer wheel/pod swap with chassis safely supported
Cold battery cartridge exchange using lift/slide tray
humanOrOffboard: Deployment or repair of failed lift until proven autonomous
Contaminated/seized/damaged interfaces beyond validated recovery envelope
Deep arm/gearbox/battery repairs and damaged structural joints

variants.name: Workshop / loose-parts
infrastructure: Bearing presses, metrology, cable preparation/crimp inspection, feeders, fixtures
Subassembly handling and force-controlled insertion tools
robotWork: Selected rigid-part pick/place/fastening after fixture redesign
Preterminated wire routing in constrained channels
humanOrOffboard: Gearbox/bearing preload, seals and lubrication unless dedicated station validated
Loose flexible wiring, crimp quality, belt threading/tensioning, press fits
Mains/high-energy electrical release and safety validation

variants.name: Field / loose-parts
infrastructure: Would require transporting a machine shop, clean assembly cell and test capability
robotWork: Only separately validated bounded repairs from small stocked items
humanOrOffboard: General fabrication, precision fitting, arbitrary broken-part reconstruction and full vehicle manufacture

components.name: Universal Robots UR20
components.role: Primary long-reach assembly arm; two-arm concept
components.environment: Arm IP65; controller IP44; pendant IP54; 0–50 C with reduced performance from 35 C; noncondensing only
components.duty: Typical program ~500 W, listed maximum 750 W; no universal continuous worst-pose duty guaranteed by these data. Vendor load/thermal cycle validation required.
components.cad: Manufacturer STEP and working-area files available; download gated by login/terms; not downloaded or validated here.
limits: 20 kg includes every wrist-mounted item and workpiece; inertia, CoM and posture matter
Cannot lift its own 64 kg replacement arm
No mud, immersion, lightning, salt-fog, off-road shock or freezing qualification established
Repeatability is not global absolute accuracy

components.name: Kinova Gen3 7 DoF
components.role: Light dexterity research alternative, not heavy rugged baseline
components.conditionalPayloadNote: 4 kg mid-range continuous; 2 kg full-range continuous, without gripper
components.environment: IP33; manufacturer lists -30 to 35 C; verify configuration
components.duty: Continuous payload explicitly specified by workspace zone; typical average 36 W
components.cad: Manufacturer lists 7 DoF CAD, end-effector reference and URDF

components.name: Kinova Link 6
components.duty: 6 kg full-range continuous with CoM 200 mm from wrist per English datasheet
components.cad: Manufacturer CAD resource exists, not downloaded
limits: English datasheet reach 1149 mm differs from older French listing 1000 mm; exact SKU/revision must be confirmed

components.name: Robotiq Hand-E 50 mm, 2020 manual configuration
components.duty: Current family page gives 5 million cycle warranty; this is not cycle-time/lifetime guarantee for this application
components.cad: Manufacturer manual provides mechanical dimensions; exact downloadable CAD variant not retrieved
limits: 5 kg form-fit and 4.7 kg friction only for specified fingers/configuration; dirty/oily parts require own grip validation
Current family page advertises 7 kg across 50/100 mm models; do not silently substitute that rating for the old 50 mm SKU
Not a 15 kg module gripper

components.name: Robotiq SD-100 reference screwdriver
components.role: Small cover, printer and bracket fasteners only
components.environment: Not independently field-qualified in reviewed evidence
components.duty: 1–600 rpm; cycle/thermal limits need exact manual
components.cad: Dimensions published; exact CAD not retrieved
limits: UR20 compatibility unverified: FAQ lists older UR3–UR16 E/CB families
4 Nm is not a structural wheel/chassis fastener solution
Compressed air supply and vacuum pickup consume mobile energy

components.name: ATI QC-20 class automatic tool changer
components.environment: Exact environmental and contamination protection unresolved
components.duty: Moment load and tool-specific dynamic cycle must be selected with manufacturer
components.cad: Manufacturer drawing/model catalog; exact final assembly not downloaded
limits: QC-11 35 lb/~15.9 kg suggested payload is too small for unrestricted 20 kg arm operation; use adequately rated alternative
QC-20 table lists 500 lbf-in XY and 310 lbf-in Z static moments, approximately 56.5 and 35.0 Nm; offset loads may govern
Lock sensors, tool ID, fail-safe retention, clean dock and managed electrical/air interfaces required

components.name: Independent goods-rated gantry + controlled hoist
components.environment: Level verified ground or engineered support pads; manufacturer operating conditions govern
components.duty: Hoist, trolley, slings and gantry all selected for task load chart and cycle
components.cad: Reference family data only; lift and deployment geometry remain unvalidated
limits: 500 kg is a provisional module-lift requirement, not whole-vehicle lifting approval
REID family 37–69 kg excludes hoist, rigging, controls and robotic deployment mechanism
Manufacturer case demonstrates people assembling the gantry, not a robot
Required hook height = fixture height + module height + rigging allowance + extraction clearance; solve with actual geometry
Arm guides heavy part only if side loads and contact forces remain inside its limits; hoist carries gravity load

components.name: Torque/angle/depth-controlled nutrunner with reaction fixture
limits: Choose torque from joint design, bolt class, preload and friction study; no generic M-size torque assumption
Reaction loads go into a rated fixture, not an unverified robot wrist

taskGraph.title: Inspect kit and worksite
actions: Read serials/BOM and weigh or load declared modules
Survey ground, weather, access lanes and kit orientation
requiredChecks: Known component mass/CoM and healthy lifting points
No missing or damaged structural components
Firm level support satisfying selected lift instructions
taskGraph.onFailure: Reject task or relocate; do not guess missing properties
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Stabilize assembler and index chassis fixture
actions: Park, inhibit traction, deploy supports and confirm mechanical locks
Survey fixture and calibrated fiducials
requiredChecks: Support reactions, ground bearing and tipping margin valid for worst arm/lift posture
No human inside hazard zone
Fixed datum transform established
taskGraph.onFailure: Stop; keep loads supported and request setup correction
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Deploy and verify heavy lift
actions: Position independent gantry around target fixture
Verify hoist limits, brakes, rigging and proof/service records
Test unloaded motion and safe stop
requiredChecks: Every component WLL exceeds planned factored module+rigging load under manufacturer chart
Clear span and hook extraction height validated
No coupling of tipping load to unsupported robot
taskGraph.onFailure: No heavy lifts; human/offboard lift setup required
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Locate chassis structural modules
actions: Lift prepared spine/crossmembers from tray into indexed fixture
Seat dowels or shear keys before clamp bolts
requiredChecks: Member mass fits hoist chart
Alignment and gap sensors confirm seating
Qualified metal structure; printed skins excluded from primary load path
taskGraph.onFailure: Return to supported cradle; inspect fit
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Fasten and inspect structural joints
actions: Use captive fasteners with single-side tool access
React nutrunner against fixture; log torque/angle/depth and joint ID
requiredChecks: Engineer-defined joint schedule, preload procedure and tool calibration
No cross-threading or unexpected torque signature
Independent release inspection until process capability established
taskGraph.onFailure: Replace affected hardware and inspect threads; no forced torque-through
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Install six suspension and traction corner groups
actions: Install 50 kg workshop / 60 kg field suspension-steering subassembly with hoist into keyed chassis mounts
Install separate 110 kg workshop / 135 kg field wheel+drive group using its own hoist-supported service interface, OR lift complete corner at 160/195 kg
Seat retention pins and engineer-specified fasteners; mate isolated harnesses
Transfer weight only after both interface joint checks
requiredChecks: Six repetitions with measured masses, no arm free-lift
Suspension stored energy isolated
Hub torque, brake wiring and seal inspection
Two explicit service splits must exist in released CAD; otherwise treat entire corner as 160/195 kg
Hoist and rigging capacity assessed for complete corner, extraction path and center of gravity
taskGraph.onFailure: Keep cradle supporting module; quarantine failed corner
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Install electronics and battery cartridges
actions: Fit pretested controller/harness tray
Slide/lift sealed battery cartridges into guided bays
Mate touch-safe keyed connectors with energy isolated
requiredChecks: Independent service power maintained
Isolation verified and connectors clean/dry
Pack undamaged; thermal fault absent; precharge/interlock logic tested before energization
taskGraph.onFailure: Do not open or repair cell pack; quarantine and obtain qualified service
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Install peer arm modules
actions: Hoist 64 kg arm to doweled service pedestal
Support arm while fastening and mating cables
Fit tool changer and tool dock
requiredChecks: Hoist carries full arm mass; no claim that one UR20 lifts another
Base flatness/preload and cable bend radius verified
Brake release and fall hazards controlled per vendor service process
taskGraph.onFailure: Leave arm supported and unpowered; offboard technician/service lift
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Fit panels, sensors and printable items
actions: Use small gripper to fit labeled parts
Fit gaskets and covers with small-fastener tool
Install protected fiducials
requiredChecks: Part within actual gripper payload and finger limits
No printed part used beyond its qualified temperature/load/environment
Connector seals and panel latch checks
taskGraph.onFailure: Reprint/rework or return part to tray
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Cold electrical and mechanical acceptance
actions: Check continuity/polarity/grounding/insulation by approved test station
Check guards, mechanical support, joint records and emergency stops
requiredChecks: Qualified test procedure accepted; no exposed hazardous energy
Correct firmware and component identities
Independent reviewer/signoff for prototype
taskGraph.onFailure: Remain isolated; diagnose without energizing unsafe circuit
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Controlled commissioning and calibration
actions: Low-energy/guarded power-on, safety-chain and precharge tests
Calibrate arm base/TCP/hand-eye, wheel radius/steering if fitted, IMU and sensors
Validate low-speed motion unloaded before load testing
requiredChecks: Safe stops and diagnostics pass
Measured joint geometry and reach/clearance agree with model
Payload, CoM and tool settings entered for every tool
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Proof of accepted peer build
actions: Document build trace and achieved performance
Run defined traction, thermal, brake, steering and manipulation tests
Inspect after shakedown
requiredChecks: Objective acceptance thresholds set before testing
No unexplained failed checks
Human-approved release until autonomous acceptance demonstrated
taskGraph.onFailure: Incomplete build; do not label self-replication proven
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Prepare printer modules
actions: Select 300 mm reference build volume for specified small parts
Stage prewired electronics, preterminated harnesses and prepared mechanical groups
requiredChecks: CAD/BOM revision fixed; all proposed printed parts pass bounding-box/orientation checks
Mains or high-current interfaces isolated
taskGraph.onFailure: Use offboard preassembly or redesign kit
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Assemble printer frame and motion system
actions: Square frame in fixture; install rail/bed/toolhead groups
Measure diagonals, belt routing/tension and rail friction
requiredChecks: Fixture supports parts during fastening
Rail alignment and belt tension measurable
Loose-belt threading not yet demonstrated robotically
taskGraph.onFailure: Human fixture-assisted intervention or redesigned preassembled gantry
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Test printer electronics and thermal protection
actions: Install pretested plug-in control tray
Run qualified electrical and heater/temperature/safety tests
requiredChecks: No live wiring
Mains safety, protective bonding and thermal cutoff accepted by qualified process
Fire-safe ventilated printing area
taskGraph.onFailure: Do not energize; offboard electrical correction
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Calibrate printer and qualify output
actions: Home, level, calibrate extrusion and print dimensional coupons
Measure coupons and fit/load test intended part family
Cool and remove print with safe release fixture
requiredChecks: Dimension, strength, orientation and environmental qualification pass
Print-removal/jam recovery bounded and tested
taskGraph.onFailure: Reject print; diagnose or request service
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

taskGraph.title: Assemble qualified printed item
actions: Inspect and identify part
Fit purchased inserts/fasteners in fixture if required
Assemble and inspect product against its drawing
requiredChecks: No assumption printer can create motors,bearings,metal structure,electronics or raw feedstock
Insert heating and loose small items require validated tooling
taskGraph.onFailure: Reject or rework under approved procedure
taskGraph.evidenceLevel: Proposed executable task specification; not physically demonstrated

repairCoverage.item: Panels, sensor mast modules, tools and small printed fixtures

repairCoverage.self: Only with independent chassis supports and healthy manipulator/lift path
repairCoverage.peer: Hoist-supported separate wheel+drive 110/135 kg; full suspension+steering+traction corner 160/195 kg if service split absent
repairCoverage.gate: Wheel unloaded; mechanical lock holds vehicle; brakes/stored suspension energy isolated

repairCoverage.self: Cold cartridge swap only, independent service power needed
repairCoverage.peer: Sealed cartridge exchange with lift or slide tray
repairCoverage.gate: No cell work, no thermal-damaged pack handling; isolation and qualified testing

repairCoverage.self: Healthy second arm may handle tools but lift supports failed arm; reach not established
repairCoverage.gate: No own loaded base release; vendor calibration/service required; failed lift or both arms requires outside help

repairCoverage.self: Only if service controller and independent safe power remain available
repairCoverage.gate: Cannot remove the only controller/power path that must execute the operation

repairCoverage.item: Gearbox internals, bearings, seals and brake overhaul
repairCoverage.peer: Workshop specialist station or service provider
repairCoverage.gate: Precision metrology, presses, preload and lubrication procedures

repairCoverage.item: Cracked structural spine, damaged arm joint or cells
repairCoverage.gate: Structural/electrical safety cannot be established by a visual animation

repairCoverage.item: Recovery after rollover, burial or lost support system
repairCoverage.peer: Recovery equipment and rated attachment plan required
repairCoverage.gate: Traction and lifting charts, terrain and failure posture assessed

printEnvelope.selectionBasis: Chosen from proposed component envelopes below, not from full vehicle dimensions. These are design constraints, not measurements of released CAD. Re-run envelope/orientation/strength checks after CAD exists.

parts.part: Jig insert or drill-free assembly locator

printEnvelope.largerParts: Tile nonstructural covers or manufacture offboard; do not scale printer to sedan size.
printEnvelope.bootstrap: First printer requires purchased parts and externally printed starter components; printing another printer does not create its rails, motors, electronics, heaters or fasteners.
printEnvelope.reference: Voron 2.4 300-class kit provides real human assembly reference and CAD; robot assembly is unproven.

structural: Metal doweled/shear-keyed interfaces with captive fasteners and one-sided access
Guide rails or cones establish pose before final bolt preload
Rated lifting eyes plus fail-safe cradles at known CoM
Avoid adhesives or hidden loose nuts as routine service joints
electrical: Preterminated tested harness cartridges, protected keyed connectors, strain relief
Blind-mate guide pins and floating connector mounts; ingress seal qualified after cycling
Separate low-voltage data/service power from traction; interlock/precharge sequence for energy connectors
Robot validates pin seating/lock and electrical test; mating motion alone is not electrical acceptance
tools: Separate small gripper, form-fit locked module gripper, low-torque driver and structural nutrunner
Force/torque sensing, wrist vision, fiducials and independent load sensing
Automatic changer with lock/unlock sensors and tool identification; rack within validated reach
Tool center of gravity and calibration updated at every change

validationGates: Collision-free inverse kinematics for complete insertion/extraction path, both arms, hoses, hoist rigging and fixture; reach sphere alone is insufficient
Payload budget: tool changer+sensor+gripper+workpiece <= posture/CoM/inertia limited manufacturer rating; dual arms cannot simply sum ratings
Heavy loads supported by certified lift; rated load path includes rigging, connectors, trolley, beam, legs, pads and ground
Static and dynamic support reactions on every outrigger plus terrain bearing and sliding check; suspension actuator rating alone does not certify a lifting support
Validate every fastener torque/angle signature and structural joint schedule
Calibrate hand-eye, base, TCP and fixture after docking or module replacement; ±0.1 mm repeatability does not guarantee bolt-hole alignment
Execute hundreds of relevant trials across tolerance, contamination, lighting, wear and power-loss conditions before claiming reliable autonomous assembly
Track intervention count, successes/attempts and uncertainty by operation rather than displaying a single autonomy percentage
humanBoundary: Qualified manufacture of cells, motors, gears, bearings, PCBAs, primary structure and safety-critical harnesses remains offboard
Human/offboard setup and lift rigging required until automatic deployment and couplers are independently validated
No live electrical repair, cell-level repair, unqualified structural welding, improvised load-bearing printed parts or unsupported work beneath suspended loads
If the only arm, controller, energy source or lift needed for repair fails, peer/offboard assistance is required

costs.status: Quote-only manufacturer equipment; no verified purchase prices obtained by this workstream

excludedClaims: No equipment quote or procurement completed
No claim published generic arm price includes controller, tooling, safety engineering or mobile integration

packagingAndAccess.peerFixture: Peer chassis on indexed longitudinal supports; all underbody connectors routed to service faces. Assembler parks outside gantry legs and moves between front, side and rear docking stations.
packagingAndAccess.gantry: Nominal 3 m beam class, target ≥2.5 m clear span around 1.8 m peer body; exact trolley travel, foot spread, hook height and approach clearance must be taken from selected SKU. Carried folded length must fit 4 m body or trailer. No claim current portable gantry self-deploys.
packagingAndAccess.stabilizers: Field concept four feet at x=±1.45 m, y=±1.40 m, mechanically locked after placement. Mobility mass allowance 120 kg is not a structural qualification.
packagingAndAccess.battery: 15.6 kg provisional cartridge exceeds the selected Hand-E capacity and the conservative 15 kg direct-workpiece target. Use load-bearing slide tray/hoist or separately qualified form-fit module gripper with full arm payload/CoM accounting.
packagingAndAccess.deploymentBootstrap: A folded gantry family can weigh more than the arm payload. Need self-erecting assisted deployment, subcomponents within safe handling envelope, peer assistance, or human setup. Until designed/tested, field autonomous deployment is blocked. The arm cannot free-lift a 150 kg carried lift system. Current field concept requires preassembled/self-erecting lift module on its own deployment mechanism, peer help or human setup; this is not engineered or proven.
packagingAndAccess.reach: 1.75 m reach is a workspace radius only. A 4 m body cannot be serviced end-to-end from one fixed central base. Repositioning, rails or multiple arm bases plus insertion-path IK are mandatory.
